clearcapital-clearcapital:lever:550fc415.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
clearcapital-clearcapital:lever:550fc415.description: The Sr. Application Security Engineer is responsible for validating that application services are designed and implemented with high security standards. The role analyzes the security of applications in tandem with their underlying services, including connected dependencies such as middle-tier systems and databases. Additionally, the Sr. Application Security Engineer addresses legacy and emerging security issues, and implements repeatable secure development practices to reduce the introduction of program design flaws that may lead to exploitation. As issues are uncovered, the application security engineer communicates with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application Security Engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused. This position is also responsible for assessing the security of applications for business-to-business initiatives, third-party relationships, outsourced solutions and vendors. The Sr. Application Security Engineer is expected to recommend programmatic controls, and monitor and manage secure development practices to address modern day issues. Application Security Engineers think like attackers, but always act with integrity and do not abuse their privilege.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:fd.title: Fitter I
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:fd.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel, located in Pineville, LA, is looking for a Fitter I to join the team. Fitters will interpret blueprints to tack fit structures including tubular steel transmission poles, latticed transmission towers, substation deadend and support structures and other specialty structures. Fitters must be capable of fitting steel layouts according to specifications. Individuals must be able to perform duties with speed and accuracy in order to produce a quality product and keep a steady flow of products. This position will frequently use calculating skills, by tape measure or other device. This position will use other moving machinery or equipment, including cranes, in order to manipulate steel structures.
responsibilities: Operates safety equipment and uses safe work habits.
Studies engineering drawings and blueprints to determine materials, requirements, and task sequences.
Plans steel layout according to specifications.
Lays out full scale drawings of structures, supports, and related equipment, following blueprints within specified tolerances.
Moves parts safely into position; manually or with hoists or cranes.
Lays out, positions, aligns, and secures parts and assemblies prior to assembly, using straightedges, combination squares, calipers, and rulers.
Measures and marks steel for manipulation.
Assembles fittings according to specifications by welding.
Recognizes, sets up, and operates hand and power tools common to the welding trade.
Positions, aligns, and welds parts to form complete structures, following blueprints and layout specifications, using machinery, welding torches, and hand tools.
Verifies conformance of steel to specifications by measuring tapes or other measuring devices.
Examines steel or workpieces to be processed to ensure that specifications are met.
Cuts material using torches and other cutting equipment common to the welding trade.
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
Welding / fitting certification or prior fitting experience preferred.
Certifications or prior experience using moving machinery, such as cranes, preferred.
Must pass on site tack test.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:7fc60a67-.title: Data scientist/ML Engineer: Personalization and automated decisioning
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:7fc60a67-.description: Gen is a global leader dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through trusted consumer brands, including Norton, Avast, and LifeLock. Our products help people live their digital lives safely, privately, and confidently. ABOUT THE ROLE Gen’s Martech organization is evolving from manually defined campaign and message-selection rules toward intelligent, learned decisioning. We’re looking for a senior/staff-level Personalization & Decisioning Engineer to become the founding engineer for this transformation. You’ll build and own the systems that decide which message or creative to deliver, to whom, and when. This includes a contextual-bandit-based message-selection platform, a content-embedding pipeline that enables new creative to generalize immediately, and the low-latency serving and feedback infrastructure that connects these capabilities to production experiences. You’ll partner with product, marketing, data science, engineering, business, and compliance stakeholders to improve relevance and outcomes while ensuring safeguards—including frequency caps, eligibility rules, customer protections, and required disclosures—remain enforced above the models. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Design, build, and operate a production-grade contextual bandit for message and campaign selection. - Own the content-embedding pipeline that supports rapid generalization to new creative without requiring a full history of prior interactions. - Build low-latency online serving systems and reliable feedback loops for impressions, selections, conversions, outcomes, and model learning. - Establish evaluation, experimentation, monitoring, and rollback practices for safe production operation. - Translate business and compliance requirements into durable system safeguards, including frequency caps, eligibility conditions, suppression rules, and disclosures. - Make pragmatic modeling and architecture choices, using the simplest approach that meets business needs and earning complexity through measurable value. - Mentor engineers and help shape the technical direction and roadmap for personalization and decisioning across Martech. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Significant experience designing and delivering production machine-learning or decisioning systems, typically at a senior or staff level. - Demonstrated experience shipping a contextual bandit, recommender system, ranking system, or comparable online decisioning capability into production. - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable, observable services, real-time inference APIs, event-driven feedback systems, and production data pipelines. - Practical knowledge of experimentation and online evaluation, including metrics, bias, exploration versus exploitation, and failure modes. - Experience with embeddings, representation learning, content understanding, or systems that generalize to new items. - Sound judgment about model complexity, operational risk, and when a simpler solution is the right one. - Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and align partners around trade-offs. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with personalization, lifecycle marketing, campaign optimization, recommender systems, or customer engagement platforms. - Experience designing deterministic policy layers and guardrails around machine-learning systems. - Familiarity with privacy, consumer protection, compliance, or regulated-product considerations in personalization. - Experience setting technical direction for a new platform and mentoring engineers across teams. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS You’ll help define how Gen connects people with the right product, message, and experience at the right time. Your work will turn personalization from a collection of static rules into an intelligent, measurable, and responsibly governed decisioning capability that can scale across Gen’s brands and customer journeys. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b2725d94-aa2b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Regional Account Manager based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead sales growth and customer development across a defined U.S. territory within the capital equipment industry. You will build trusted relationships with customers at multiple organizational levels, from plant and maintenance leaders to managers and engineers. The position combines new equipment sales, account development, aftermarket opportunities, and strategic territory management. You will become deeply knowledgeable about customer operations, equipment usage, production environments, and maintenance needs to identify valuable growth opportunities. Working closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams, you will manage a healthy pipeline and ensure successful execution from opportunity through delivery. The role is highly customer-facing, with significant travel required to maximize in-person engagement, demonstrations, and business development. This is an ideal opportunity for a motivated, organized sales professional who thrives on achieving ambitious goals and developing long-term customer partnerships. Develop and strengthen relationships with customers, prospects, and active accounts across multiple levels, including complex managers, plant management, maintenance managers, and engineering teams. Build deep knowledge of the active customer base, including existing equipment, production processes, maintenance practices, and evolving business needs. Promote and sell the full range of equipment solutions within the assigned territory, including complete new equipment lines, replacement equipment, spare parts, and services associated with equipment sales. Develop and execute a structured customer communication and territory travel plan designed to maximize face-to-face engagement and identify new opportunities. Partner with sales leadership to develop corporate-level plans, territory growth strategies, and account development initiatives. Identify and coordinate opportunities for customer demonstrations, both at customer facilities and designated demonstration locations. Identify opportunities to expand existing equipment portfolios and introduce new products and solutions to customers. Promote aftermarket programs, consumable parts, equipment services, and other value-added offerings across the existing customer base. Collaborate with research and development and service teams to support customer demonstrations and address customer requirements. Work closely with production, engineering, and logistics teams throughout sold projects to ensure smooth execution and strong customer satisfaction. Partner with service teams to coordinate sold items and identify additional service and aftermarket opportunities. Support additional commercial and customer initiatives as required by leadership. Requirements 5–10 years of relevant experience in capital equipment sales or a closely related B2B sales environment. Demonstrated ability to develop long-term customer relationships and manage complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Experience managing and growing a defined sales territory, including prospecting, account development, pipeline management, and opportunity conversion. Experience using CRM platforms to maintain customer information, track opportunities, and manage sales pipelines. Basic proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint or comparable Google Workspace applications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, technical teams, and senior stakeholders. Strong customer relationship management and consultative selling capabilities. Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:06ad9ffd-d94.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided

jobDescription.title: Project Epsilon - Korean Quality Control Specialist
